'''2012 Bespin Regionals John Anderson LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
